title: Screaming Emoji
blurb: Digital panic in its purest available form, attached to the melting, disintegrating emoji that mostly conveys total structural collapse. The wail is abstract enough to fit any crisis and dramatic enough that none of them strictly deserve it — a battery hitting one per cent, a deadline arriving without warning, a message reading 'we need to talk' with no follow-up for eleven minutes. That is exactly the right calibration for internet emotion, where scale is optional. Play it when the situation is bad, or merely feels bad, which is functionally identical.
origin: The scream paired with the disintegrating-emoji meme.
